scales.divisionHint: The smallest step the instrument reports. A bridge reading in 20 kg steps can never settle inside a 5 kg tolerance.

gateways.secretBody: It is shown once and never again. The gateway signs every packet with it, so a lost secret is replaced rather than recovered.
gateways.rotateBody: The current secret stops working immediately. The gateway cannot send readings until the new one is installed on it.

integrity.broken: {count, plural, one {# break found} other {# breaks found}}. The reading history has been altered.

reason.link_broken: A reading was removed or reordered

rules.frozenHint: These are the thresholds that judged this weighing, not the ones configured now.

weighingRules.title: Detection settings
weighingRules.subtitle: The thresholds that decide what counts as tampering
weighingRules.immutableHint: Publishing creates a new version. Weighings already judged keep the thresholds that judged them, so changing a value here can never clear existing history.
weighingRules.readOnly: These thresholds are set by MSE Trace and cannot be changed from a customer account. They decide what the platform treats as tampering, so a company cannot widen its own. Contact support if a weighbridge needs different settings.

projects.count: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}

team.title: Who can see this project
team.description: People here see this project's deliveries and outgoing loads. Everyone else in your company sees nothing of it unless their role covers every project.
team.removeDescription: They will stop seeing this project's deliveries and outgoing loads. Their account and everything they recorded stay as they are.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: This project will no longer appear anywhere. Deliveries and loads already recorded against it stay in place.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.count: {count, plural, =0 {No suppliers} one {# supplier} other {# suppliers}}

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: This supplier will no longer appear when recording a delivery. Deliveries already recorded from them stay in place.

qrCodes.title: Delivery dockets
qrCodes.description: A docket ties one supplier to one project. Scanning it on site fills in both at once, so recording a delivery takes seconds.
qrCodes.count: {count, plural, =0 {No dockets} one {# docket} other {# dockets}}

revoke.title: Revoke this docket?
revoke.description: Printed copies stop working immediately. Deliveries already recorded with it stay exactly as they are.

receipts.title: Material receipts
receipts.count: {count, plural, =0 {No receipts} one {# receipt} other {# receipts}}
receipts.stampNote: The time, place and person are recorded by the platform when the receipt is filed. They cannot be typed in or changed afterwards.
receipts.editNote: The quantity and price can be corrected. The project, the docket and the recorded time cannot — they are what the receipt is evidence of.

summary.title: Material summary
summary.note: Quantities are grouped by unit. Tonnes and pieces are not added together.

remove.title: Remove receipt {name}?
remove.description: It will no longer appear in your deliveries or your material totals.

dispatches.title: Waste dispatches
dispatches.count: {count, plural, =0 {No loads} one {# load} other {# loads}}
dispatches.recyclerNote: Loads can only be sent to recyclers registered on MSE Trace. That is what puts the load on a weighbridge and keeps the trail going past your gate.
dispatches.recyclerEmpty: No recyclers are available right now.
dispatches.estimateNote: Your estimate. The recycler's weighbridge decides the final weight, and both are kept.
dispatches.lockedNote: This load has left the site, so it can no longer be changed. Cancel it if it never arrives.

release.title: Release this load?
release.description: Records that the lorry has left. After this, the load can be cancelled but not changed.

cancel.title: Cancel this load?
cancel.description: Say why. The reason stays on the record so the recycler and your own team can see what happened.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: This draft will no longer appear anywhere. Nothing has left the site yet.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Material in and waste out, across the projects you can see.

receipts.title: Material received
receipts.unitNote: Quantities are grouped by unit. Tonnes and pieces are never added together — a single total across both would look like an answer and would not be one.
receipts.chartNote: The chart counts deliveries, which compare across units. Quantities are in the table.

dispatches.title: Waste dispatched
dispatches.estimateNote: These are the site's estimates. Final weights come from the recycler's weighbridge once the load is weighed.

reports.empty: Nothing to report for this selection yet.

incoming.title: Incoming loads
incoming.subtitle: Waste on its way to your yards.
incoming.count: {count, plural, =0 {No loads} one {# load} other {# loads}}
incoming.declaredNote: The producer's declaration. Your weighbridge decides the final weight, and both are kept.

collect.title: Take this load on?
collect.description: Records that the material is now in your hands. The producer can no longer cancel it, and the weighbridge decides what it was.
collect.referenceHint: Optional. Use your own numbering if you run one.

reject.title: Refuse this load?
reject.description: Say why. The reason goes back to the site that sent it, so they know what happened to the lorry.

gate.title: Weighbridge gate
gate.subtitle: Scan the driver's dispatch note before the vehicle drives on.
gate.whyFirst: The weighbridge starts recording by itself when weight lands on the deck, so the load has to be queued before the vehicle moves. There is no way to attach it afterwards.
gate.noScales: No weighbridges are set up yet.
gate.nothingQueued: Nothing is queued at this weighbridge.
gate.expired: This scan has expired. Scan again before the vehicle drives on.
gate.plateMismatch: The plate on the paperwork is {expected}. Check the cab.
gate.clearDescription: Nothing will be attached to the next vehicle that drives on. Use this if the driver turned around or the wrong note was scanned.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.count: {count, plural, =0 {No vehicles} one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}}

tare.title: Record this vehicle's empty weight
tare.description: On a yard weighing against a stored tare, this figure is subtracted from every load this lorry ever brings in. Lowering it by 500 kg adds 500 kg to every net weight, so the change is written to the audit log with your reason.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: This vehicle will no longer appear when assigning a trip. Trips already recorded against it stay in place.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.count: {count, plural, =0 {No drivers} one {# driver} other {# drivers}}

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: They will no longer appear when assigning a trip. Trips already recorded against them stay in place.

tasks.title: Collection trips
tasks.count: {count, plural, =0 {No trips} one {# trip} other {# trips}}
tasks.advanceDescription: Recorded against the trip, with the time.
tasks.loadedNote: Marking the lorry loaded also tells the producer the waste has changed hands. From then they can no longer cancel it.
tasks.failNote: Say what went wrong. Somebody has to chase this, and they need to know what they are chasing.
tasks.noPhotos: The driver has not sent any photos.
tasks.locationNote: Where the driver's device said it was. Browser location can be faked, so this records what was reported, not where the lorry was.
tasks.reassignNote: Only before the driver accepts. After that the roster is a record of who actually went.

deductions.title: Deductions
deductions.count: {count, plural, =0 {No deductions} one {# deduction} other {# deductions}}
deductions.thresholdNote: Anything over {threshold} kg goes to the producer to accept. Below that it is accepted automatically — a hundred kilos of damp on a twenty-tonne load is not worth a conversation, and making it one teaches everybody to click accept without reading.
deductions.autoAcceptedNote: Nobody was asked about this one: it was under the threshold in force at the time.
deductions.reasonHint: Enough detail to be read six months from now by somebody who was not there.
deductions.photoNote: The material is on a pile by the time anyone disputes this. Photographs taken at the inspection are the only evidence that survives.

respond.title: Answer this deduction
respond.noteRequired: Say why, so the yard knows what to do next.
respond.effect: Accepting takes {weight} kg off what this load settles at.

deductions.onlyProducer: Only the producer of this waste can answer a deduction.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.count: {count, plural, =0 {No settlements} one {# settlement} other {# settlements}}
settlements.frozenNote: These figures were fixed when the settlement was issued. They do not change if a weighing or a deduction is touched afterwards.

issue.title: Issue this settlement
issue.description: Fixes the weights and puts the figure in front of the producer.
issue.blockedByDeductions: {count, plural, one {# deduction is} other {# deductions are}} still waiting on the producer. Settle that first.
issue.blockedByWeighing: This load has no completed weighing to settle from.

lock.title: Lock this settlement?
lock.description: Ends the producer's ability to dispute anything on this load. Say why.

payment.title: Record a payment
payment.description: Evidence of what was paid. The platform does not move money; this is what one side says happened.

quote.title: What this would settle at
quote.openDeductions: {count, plural, one {# deduction} other {# deductions}} still waiting

driver.nothingAssigned: Nothing assigned to you right now.
driver.arrivedNote: Records that you are at the site, with your phone's location if it will give one.

ticket.title: Weighbridge ticket
ticket.footer: Produced by MSE Trace. Every reading behind this weighing is stored unaltered and can be re-verified against the hashes above.
ticket.evidenceNote: These hashes chain this weighing to every reading the instrument sent. Any change to a stored reading breaks the chain from that point on.
ticket.voidWeightsNote: This weighing did not pass the checks, so no net weight has been derived from it. The readings above are shown for reference only and must not be settled against.

verdict.validNote: This weighing passed every check in force at the time.
verdict.voidNote: One or more checks failed. This ticket is a record of what happened, not a basis for payment.

tareSource.MEASURED: The tare was measured on this weighbridge.
tareSource.STORED: The tare was taken from the vehicle's record, not measured on this visit.
